source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 22:30 binds Hebrew 23:1; public 23:1–25 binds Hebrew 23:2–26. All other verses in chapters 19–26 align directly. All 179 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Retains your God addressed to the priest, rather than adopting the my God variant; keeps singular declarant within communal promise.
Selects wandering for oved while noting perishing; preserves father, Aramean, resident status, and few-to-many movement.
Preserves three distinct denials, including the obscure dead-related use, without inventing a particular ritual.
Renders the rare causative declaration verb within the mutual covenant affirmation; keeps every human obligation.
Preserves the reciprocal declaration and the obligation attached to treasured status, without making God the keeper of the commands.
